title: The last photo Voyager 1 ever took
title_options: The last photo Voyager 1 ever took
Every human who ever lived is in this pixel
NASA turned the camera around one last time
Why this blurry dot is NASA's most famous photo
description:
On February 14, 1990, Voyager 1 took 60 images for a 'Family Portrait' of the solar system; in one of them, Earth is a crescent just 0.12 pixel wide.

Sources: https://images.nasa.gov/details/PIA00452 , https://images.nasa.gov/details/PIA23645
Credits: all images NASA/JPL-Caltech (PIA23645, PIA14111, PIA23681, PIA00452, PIA17048).
Narration voice is AI-generated.
